title: ClickHouse async inserts from Node.js: per-row vs batch vs async_insert
outcome: Insert the same 1,000 rows from Node per row, in client batches and with async_insert, and count the parts each creates: 1,000, 4, 10 and 1.

env.name: CLICKHOUSE_USERNAME
env.description: ClickHouse user with INSERT, CREATE TABLE and SYSTEM rights (default: default)

env.name: CLICKHOUSE_PASSWORD
env.description: ClickHouse password (default: hypequery, the seed's password)

env.name: CLICKHOUSE_DATABASE
env.description: Database for the recipe's ingest table (default hypequery_examples)
